sections.text: EWSR1::FEV is a rare Ewing sarcoma fusion. Molecular analysis demonstrates EWSR1 joined to FEV with retention of the FEV ETS DNA-binding domain; directly studied tumors show primitive round-cell morphology.

audit_evidence.scope: Direct EWSR1-FEV/FUS-FEV cases; targeted RNA sequencing demonstrates EWSR1 exon 8-FEV exon 2; all sequenced fusions retain FEV ETS DNA-binding exon 3.
